project.name: osgi/foundation/seed-broker-runtime
project.description: The ONE broker door's mechanism: DefaultSeedBroker, the @Component that collects every SeedHandler by Declarative Services and dispatches a seed by the WANTED coordinate. The door contract (SeedBroker, SeedHandler) is the neutral seed-broker seam; this module is the grower behind it. A foundation because the broker serves ALL domains and BOTH worlds (the dual-axis integrator the atlas validated). Unlike the seam it serves (system-exported, never installed), this is a plain @Component installed AND activated in-container (embed type=runtime): a runtime mechanism, not a domain model — so it activates like a model yet its nature is honestly its own.
